observations.observation: Velocity at 0.787x while acceleration holds at 1.005x — the system is growing faster than its recent rate even as absolute throughput remains below the 1.0x floor. This velocity-below-1.0x / acceleration-above-1.0x split has now persisted for 5+ consecutive cycles, suggesting a structural recovery phase where the growth rate is compounding even as raw volume stays suppressed.

9 new CBSAs entered the signal window this heartbeat (47.4% diffusion rate — 9 of 19 active metros are new), including non-metro NC, WV, FL, NY, MA, WI and metro areas 41740, 37980, 33100. This is the sixth large geographic burst in 8 cycles — sustained multi-cycle expansion continues with no return to the pulse-then-silence pattern.

Velocity dropped to 0.743x this heartbeat (from 0.902x last cycle) while acceleration holds at 1.014x — a significant velocity pullback even as the growth rate remains above 1.0x. This is the sharpest single-cycle velocity drop since the sub-0.75x floor period, suggesting the structural recovery may be entering a consolidation phase.

Grocery & Supermarkets appeared as a new category this heartbeat — the first time this category has entered the signal window. Combined with the Pharmacy/Health expansion from prior cycles, the category mix is broadening beyond retail into everyday consumables.
